author: M P
content:
highly recommended! We hired a large bouncy castle, the didi cars and a hall using Elliot for our 5 year old's birthday party. They were very easy to communicate and on the day everything went really smooth. Booking the hall through them meant that I didn't need manage two different bookings and they knew the size of the hall and how to set things up. so less stress for us.

Everyone had a fantastic time and loved the bouncy castle and the cars.
